title: Assurance deployment phases and gate synchronization for SOC2/ISO onboarding
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define and execute a phased rollout plan that synchronizes cross-functional gates (product, engineering, security, and customer success) for SOC2 and ISO onboarding. Deliverables include a sequenced checklist for evidence collection, cutover windows for SSO/SAML, audit-logs retention rollout, and automated validation hooks into the Console. The goal is to enable enterprise customers to opt into compliance tiers with predictable timelines and clear rollback paths.
success_criteria: Gate orchestration document approved by Security and Legal
Automated evidence upload pipeline validates 95% of required artifacts in sandbox
SSO/SAML cutover playbooks complete and dry-run executed with two pilot customers
Audit-log retention policy implemented and surfaced in Console with per-tenant controls
No severity-1 incidents during staged rollouts for pilot clusters
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Discovery & artifact mapping (Nov-Dec 2025) - Inventory controls, owners, and evidence locations. Phase 1: Proof-of-concept automation (Jan 2026) - Build E2E evidence ingestion pipeline + Console UI to show evidence status. Phase 2: Pilot wave (Feb-Mar 2026) - 2 pilot customers, SSO cutover in low-traffic window, observe telemetry for 4 weeks. Phase 3: Canary to enterprise (Apr 2026) - Gradual expansion by region, enable per-tenant retention toggles. Phase 4: General availability (May 2026) - GA with SLA addendum and audit support docs. Each phase includes a mandatory security review and rollback checklist. Cutover windows: prefer UTC 0100-0500 and include a 48-hour pre-cutover smoke test.
notes: Trade-off: full automation of evidence ingestion reduces manual work but increases upfront engineering scope; decided to scope to 70% automation for phase 1 and backlog the remaining rule parsers.
Decision: use tenant-level audit-log retention configuration rather than a global config to support customer-specific regulatory needs.
Risk: SSO cutover has dependency on IdP vendors for metadata refresh; plan includes manual fallback instructions and grace period tokens.
Operational constraint: Dedicated clusters will require ops runbook updates and an upgrade path that preserves existing KV cache state during the rollout.
